propositions: complexity-baseline.json lacks a CI lock unlike module-size-limit.txt, allowing any contributor to change it without administrator override
the baseline can grow by adding new entries because tests verify entry count matches live functions but do not enforce that the entry count is monotonically non-increasing
the module-size lock fails open on missing main fetch (emits warning and skips comparison), allowing changes to pass unverified when git operations flake
the lock must be semantic and entry-directional: reject raised ceilings or added entries, but allow removed entries and lowered ceilings to pass without override
a function added above the C901 threshold with a matching baseline entry added in the same change must fail CI unless an administrator overrides
